design:
R7 the remaining recipes, after the first six reproduced without an exception.

Design fixed before running (2026-09-16, written 12:05 EDT). snap-r7-verify rescored the first six
recipes in sorted order at 150M and matched every branch it could load. The default branch reproduced
released seed 2, small-aux-2 reproduced seed 14 and small-aux-3 reproduced seed 15, in all four recipes
whose repositories resolved, with eleven of the twelve correlations at 0.99999997 or better and the best
wrong seed never above 0.897. Two recipes failed to resolve, and the error was a missing identifier
rather than a refused request, so the names built from the released run files don't match the repository
names for those two. Twelve cells in three hundred and seventy three seconds is cheap enough to finish
the census, so this run takes the remaining nineteen recipes and settles two things at once. It says
whether the seed mapping holds across the whole battery rather than across a convenience sample, and it
records exactly which repositories a reader can and cannot fetch, which is the provenance question the
paper currently answers with an aggregate count. The scoring and checkpoint mapping are unchanged.
